{{Conjecture|legends}}
When the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] flew over the dangerous [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in an [[Explorer craft]] in search of his missing son, [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]], he flew over a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] which a long-necked, light blue creature was swimming through. The creature watched the Explorer craft as it flew by.<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook">''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The creature strongly resembled a Plesiosaur, a real-life aquatic creature which went extinct millions of years ago.<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" />
